mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, name, title, department, avatar, experience, specialties, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, password, name, title, department, avatar, experience, specialties, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, username, password, name, title, department, avatar, experience, specialties, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor WHERE department = #{department} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, password, name, title, department, avatar, experience, specialties, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, password, name, title, department, avatar, experience, specialties, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
